title: Social Media Marketing Needed: Meta Ads, Instagram, Facebook Ads, SEO
description: I run ThoughtProduct Media in the Philadelphia and Bucks County area, and I’ve been a full-time videographer for over 10 years. I’m looking for someone who knows Meta Ads Manager and can work with me directly to launch paid ads for my own business. I want to sit down together, in person or over a screen share, and learn by setting up a real campaign with you. I already have videos ready to post on Instagram. My goal is to reach business owners who are looking for more than a one-time shoot. My team comes up with content ideas, writes scripts, films, and edits. I want to use Facebook and Instagram ads to bring in clients who need that kind of content regularly. For the first paid project, I’d like you to help me pick a video, get my accounts and billing set up correctly, and build and launch a campaign in Meta Ads Manager. I want to understand how to choose an audience, set a budget, and track which ads actually lead to qualified inquiries. I’d also like to review the results together once the ads have run and talk through what we should change. I’m looking for someone who has personally run paid campaigns and is comfortable explaining what they’re doing as we go. Longer term, I’d like to offer this to clients too, with my team handling production and you potentially managing the ads. But the first step is getting it working for my own business. If you’re interested, send me your rate, your availability, and a quick example of a campaign you personally managed. I’d especially like to hear about one where the goal was getting leads for a service business: what you spent, what came in, and what you learned.
